text: Given the JSON post records in /static/synthetic/posts/ — fb_001, fb_002, fb_003, tiktok_001, telegram_001, telegram_002, telegram_003, instagram_001, instagram_002, discord_001, x_001, whatsapp_001, sms_001 — generate: (1) operator-chain inferences (which records likely share an operator? evidence?); (2) corridor heatmap (which corridors are over-represented in the dataset?); (3) the 3 highest-priority records for regulator notification + why; (4) data-quality caveats.
